judge.rationale: All answers share PTPRC exon-4 splicing as the CD45RA/CD45RO mechanism, and B–D additionally share HNRNPLL, but A instead relies on PTBP1, hnRNP L, SFPQ, PI3K–AKT, and GSK3 while the state-marker sets also diverge, so more than half of the complete molecular content differs and the shared-minority ceiling of 4 applies.
